Tehsil And District Sriganganagar.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Hemant Dutt

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Rajpurohit, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN MONGA Order 09/10/2024 1.

Petitioners are before this Court seeking quashing of an FIR No.305/2024 dated 01.06.2024,
registered at Police Station Anoopgarh, District Anoopgarh, for the offences under Sections 420 &
406 of IPC.

2. Heard.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioners argues that dispute between the parties is purely civil in nature.
There were certain monetary transaction between petitioners and the respondent Nos.2 to 4.
Petitioners assert that FIR has been registered on the basis of false allegations levelled against them.

The same thus deserves to be quashed.
[2024:RJ-JD:41325] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-6899/2024]
4. Having heard the contentions and upon perusal of case file and the FIR, I am of the view that it would not be appropriate to invoke the discretionary jurisdiction vested under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
and quash the FIR summarily on the basis of self serving affidavit of petitioners/accused.

sentences.text: 7. Meanwhile, petitioners are directed to join the investigation.

If during the investigation, in case any incriminating material of such nature is found against the petitioners, which prima facie is suggestive of any cognizable offence committed by them, warranting their custody, then a fresh notice under Section 35 of BNSS shall be given to them so as to enable them to seek legal remedy in accordance with the law.
8. Conversely, it is made clear that in case there is no incriminating material found against the petitioners, appropriate report be filed before the competent court expeditiously.
9. The instant petition is accordingly disposed of.
10. Pending application(s), if any, also stand disposed of.
